LanguageData.OLWC_NotMechanitor: {0} needs a mechlink to command the resurrection core.
LanguageData.OLWC_NotOurMech: {0} is not one of your mechs.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeRegen: Recharges {0} of its capacity per day; next charge in {1}.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeFull: Fully charged. Recharges {0} of its capacity per day.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeCorpseAge: Mechs dead for up to {0} can be resurrected.
LanguageData.OLWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the overlord warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.OLWC_ChargesDesc: The number of resurrection charges the armor's core holds when full. A core already holding more than this loses the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_RegenDesc: How much of the core's capacity recharges each day, as a percentage; whole charges are banked as they complete. At 0% the core never recharges. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CorpseAgeDesc: How long after a mech's death it can still be resurrected, in real seconds at normal speed. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CastTimeDesc: How long the core primes before the pulse resolves. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a pulse before starting another. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_RequireMechlinkDesc: Whether the pilot must be a mechanitor to use the resurrection core. Off, any pilot can bring back the colony's mechs.
LanguageData.OLWC_SparksOnlyDraftedDesc: The armor crackles with red sparks while its core holds a charge. On, your pilots show them only while drafted. Off, they play whenever the core is charged, as on an apocriton. Raiders in the set cannot be drafted, so theirs play whenever their core is charged either way.
LanguageData.OLWC_ResurrectSummary: The core holds up to {0} charges, {1}: {2}. A mech can be brought back for {3} after it falls. A pulse takes {4} to cast, with {5} of cooldown after.
LanguageData.OLWC_ResurrectSummaryNoCooldown: The core holds up to {0} charges, {1}: {2}. A mech can be brought back for {3} after it falls. A pulse takes {4} to cast, and the next can start at once.
LanguageData.OLWC_SectionWorkDesc: The work a pilot of the overlord set may take on. Every other work type follows VFE Pirates' warcasket trait as your other mods leave it, so a mod that opens work for every warcasket opens it for the overlord too.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkDesc: Whether a pilot of the overlord set can do this work. A change reaches entombed pilots at once; work newly enabled starts unassigned in the Work tab.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkNote_Research: Hacking is research work, so a pilot who cannot research cannot hack either.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkNote_Smithing: Mech gestation, subcore encoding and mech repair are smithing work.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkSummary: The pilot can take on {0} work. All other work follows VFE Pirates' warcasket rules.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkSummaryNone: The pilot takes on none of this work. All other work follows VFE Pirates' warcasket rules.
